title: Firestarter
headline: The Prodigy's dancer sang this song.
caption:
Liam Howlett built "Firestarter" as an instrumental and would have been happy with a vocal sample. Then Keith Flint, the band's dancer, asked to try singing on it. The riff is the Breeders' "S.O.S." (hence Kim Deal's writing credit), and the video put Flint's brand-new punk look in a disused tunnel at Aldwych station.

The BBC banned that video after Top of the Pops, Chris Evans wouldn't play the song on his radio show, and the band still turned down money to re-edit it. The dancer's first vocal spent three weeks at UK number one.

Did the ban make you want it more?

🎧 The song: "Firestarter" by The Prodigy (@theprodigyofficial)

Source: Liam Howlett to NME, March 1996; Wikipedia ("Firestarter", "Keith Flint", "The Prodigy", "Aldwych tube station")
